Done. The task passed on the first execution.

**What I built:** `out/T3/solution.py`, a plain torch plus safetensors script. It loads the two input shards, casts the 112 projection matrices matched by an anchored regex to bfloat16, and leaves the other two tensors as untouched float32. All required checks are assertions that run before any file is written, plus a post-write read-back that verifies dtypes and bit-exact values on disk.

**Output:** `out/T3/` holds 10 shards and an index file mapping all 114 tensors. The embedding and lm_head each sit alone in a shard since they exceed the 256 MiB budget. The remaining eight shards are packed greedily in index order and each stay under the limit.

**Report:** `out/T3/REPORT.md` records one execution, no failures, and the tools used with reasons.
